subject.title: fix(cli-runner): use sender metadata in CLI session history user labels

question: Should CLI reseed history treat the three persisted `__openclaw` sender fields as model-visible participant attribution for existing group-session transcripts?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and uses the merged persistence contract, but it changes how untrusted channel identity is represented in prompts across persisted session history; that boundary needs an owner-confirmed policy choice rather than an inferred reviewer decision.

options.title: Approve canonical attribution
options.body: Confirm that the persisted sender fields are the intended model-visible attribution source, then rebase and land this focused renderer change.

options.title: Keep history role-only
options.body: Retain the existing `User:` rendering and close or redirect the change if sender identity must not be surfaced in reseed prompts.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical attribution
recommendation.body: Confirm that the persisted sender fields are the intended model-visible attribution source, then rebase and land this focused renderer change.

likelyOwner.reason: Pick-cat introduced the merged durable envelope contract whose allowed fields and trust boundary determine whether this renderer use is appropriate.
